description_en: Queries the availability status of the log analysis feature
description_zh: 查询日志分析功能可用状态
name: DescribeLogShipperStatus

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the request source. The value is fixed to sas
parameters.help_zh: 请求来源标识，固定取值为sas
parameters.name: from

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the member accounts in the resource folder. The member accounts are Alibaba Cloud accounts.
You can invoke the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: resource_directory_account_id

AuthStatus.description_en:
The service authorization status of the log analysis feature. Valid values:

yes: Authorized.
no: Not authorized
AuthStatus.description_zh:
日志分析服务授权状态。取值：

yes：授权
no：未授权

BuyStatus.description_en:
The purchase status of the log analysis feature. Valid values:

yes: Purchased.
no: Not purchased
BuyStatus.description_zh:
日志分析服务购买状态。取值：

yes：购买
no：未购买

EtlMetaVersion.description_en:
The version of the delivered fields for log analysis. Valid values:

SAS_V1
SAS_V2
EtlMetaVersion.description_zh:
日志分析投递字段版本。取值：

SAS_V1
SAS_V2

OpenStatus.description_en:
The activation status of log analysis. Valid values:

yes: Delivered.
no: Not delivered
OpenStatus.description_zh:
日志分析开通状态。取值：

yes：投递
no：未投递

PostPaidOpenStatus.description_en:
The activation status of the pay-as-you-go billing method for the log analysis feature. Valid values:

yes: Activated.
no: Not activated
PostPaidOpenStatus.description_zh:
日志分析后付费开通状态。取值：

yes：开通
no：未开通

PostPaidSupportStatus.description_en:
The support status of the pay-as-you-go billing method for the log analysis feature. Valid values:

yes: Supported.
no: Not supported
PostPaidSupportStatus.description_zh:
日志分析后付费支持状态。取值：

yes：支持
no：未支持

SlsProjectStatus.description_en:
The status of the Log Service project used for log analysis. Valid values:

Normal: Normal.
Disable: Disabled
SlsProjectStatus.description_zh:
日志分析所使用的日志项目状态。取值：

Normal：正常
Disable：禁用

SlsServiceStatus.description_en:
The activation status of Simple Log Service (SLS). Valid values:

yes: Activated.
no: Not activated
SlsServiceStatus.description_zh:
SLS服务开通状态。取值：

yes：开通
no：未开通

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The ID is generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
